<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=1365, height=768, initial-scale=1">
<meta name="upstream-hash" content="d92f1d990c53245675adb83d1ab739b3b659c0a116902b736340201349b89302">
<meta name="artifact" content="experience:reina-g3-multiplication:experience-engineer:v1">
<title>The Signal Tower — Seven Rooms of the Grid Machine</title>
<style>
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
html,body{height:100%;background:#04090d;overflow:hidden;font-family:"Trebuchet MS","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;color:#eee2cc;user-select:none}
#fit{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center}
#stage{width:1365px;height:768px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;transform-origin:center center;
  background:radial-gradient(120% 90% at 20% 20%,#12303c 0%,#0a1a22 55%,#050d12 100%)}
#stage.dawn{background:radial-gradient(120% 90% at 20% 20%,#2b2436 0%,#14202c 55%,#070d14 100%)}
#stage.storm{background:radial-gradient(120% 90% at 20% 20%,#16323a 0%,#0d1a1e 55%,#04090c 100%)}
button{font-family:inherit;color:inherit;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer}
.hidden{display:none !important}

/* ---------- LEFT PANEL ---------- */
#left{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:819px;height:768px;padding:16px 18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px}
#hdr{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:14px;height:34px;flex:0 0 auto}
#phase{font-size:14px;letter-spacing:3px;color:#c9922e;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:700}
#roomTitle{font-size:20px;color:#f4e9d2;font-weight:700}
#prompt{flex:0 0 auto;min-height:58px;font-size:19px;line-height:1.32;color:#f2e7d1;border-left:4px solid #c9922e;padding:4px 0 4px 12px}
#prompt b{color:#ffcd7a}
#work{flex:1 1 auto;position:relative;background:rgba(255,255,255,.028);border:1px solid rgba(201,146,46,.22);border-radius:14px;padding:12px 14px;overflow:hidden}
#footer{flex:0 0 auto;height:128px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:168px 1fr 208px;gap:12px}

#intercomBtn{width:100%;height:100%;border:2px solid rgba(201,146,46,.45);border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(#13272f,#0d1d24);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:5px;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:2px;color:#d9c393;transition:.15s}
#intercomBtn:hover{border-color:#ffb545;color:#ffd79a}
#intercomBtn small{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:0;color:#9db0b8;text-transform:none}
.speaker{width:44px;height:26px;border-radius:5px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#2a3d45 0 3px,#16262d 3px 6px);border:1px solid #3d545e}
#intercomBtn.pulse{animation:softpulse 2s ease-in-out 3}
@keyframes softpulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 rgba(255,181,69,0)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(255,181,69,.45)}}

#plate{border-radius:12px;padding:11px 14px;font-size:17px;line-height:1.3;overflow:hidden;
  background:linear-gradient(160deg,#3a3020,#241d12);border:2px solid #6b5527;color:#d9c9a5;display:flex;align-items:center}
#plate.good{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#c9922e,#8a6218);border-color:#ffd79a;color:#1c1305;font-weight:600;box-shadow:0 0 24px rgba(255,181,69,.35)}
#plate.fault{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#2c3238,#1b2126);border-color:#5d6e78;color:#d4dde2}
#plate.nudge{border-color:#c9922e;color:#f0dfb6}

#send{width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:14px;border:2px solid #8a6a26;background:linear-gradient(#c9922e,#8a5f18);
  color:#1a1208;font-size:25px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:2px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px;transition:.12s}
#send .knob{width:54px;height:12px;border-radius:6px;background:#4a3714;box-shadow:inset 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.25)}
#send.ready{box-shadow:0 0 26px rgba(255,181,69,.55)}
#send:active{transform:translateY(3px)}
#send.next{background:linear-gradient(#8fd07f,#3f8a48);border-color:#2f6b36;color:#06210c;font-size:20px}

/* hint panel */
#hintPanel{position:absolute;left:18px;bottom:150px;width:430px;max-height:330px;z-index:40;
  background:linear-gradient(#132a33,#0c1b22);border:2px solid #c9922e;border-radius:14px;padding:12px;box-shadow:0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.6);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.hp-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:2px;color:#c9922e}
#hintClose{font-size:13px;color:#9db0b8;border:1px solid #3d545e;border-radius:6px;padding:4px 9px}
#hintList{overflow:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;max-height:190px}
.hintItem{font-size:16px;line-height:1.28;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border-left:3px solid #ffb545;padding:7px 9px;border-radius:6px}
.hintItem .hn{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:2px;color:#c9922e;display:block;margin-bottom:2px}
#hintMore{min-height:52px;border-radius:10px;border:2px solid #c9922e;background:rgba(201,146,46,.16);font-size:16px;color:#ffd79a}
#hintMore[disabled]{opacity:.45;border-color:#5d6e78;color:#9db0b8;cursor:default}

/* ---------- RIGHT PANEL / TOWER ---------- */
#right{position:absolute;left:819px;top:0;width:546px;height:768px;padding:14px 16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
#deck{height:52px;border-radius:12px 12px 4px 4px;border:2px solid rgba(201,146,46,.35);background:linear-gradient(#122a33,#0b1c23);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:4px;color:#7d9099;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
#deck.armed{color:#ffd79a;border-color:#ffb545;box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(255,181,69,.4)}
#towerBody{flex:1 1 auto;display:flex;gap:8px;min-height:0}
#voltWrap{width:18px;border-radius:9px;border:1px solid rgba(201,146,46,.35);background:#0a1a20;position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:flex-end}
#voltFill{width:100%;height:0;background:linear-gradient(#ffd79a,#c9922e);transition:height .7s ease}
#roomsCol{flex:1 1 auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column-reverse;gap:7px;min-height:0}
.room{flex:1 1 0;min-height:0;border:2px solid rgba(201,146,46,.22);border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(#0c1d24,#091820);
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 82px;grid-template-rows:auto 1fr;column-gap:6px;padding:5px 8px;position:relative;transition:border-color .3s,box-shadow .4s,background .4s}
.room .pilot{position:absolute;left:-1px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:6px;height:22px;border-radius:3px;background:#243740}
.room.active .pilot{background:#ffb545;animation:blink 1.15s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes blink{0%,100%{opacity:.25}50%{opacity:1}}
.rname{font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:#7d9099;text-transform:uppercase}
.room.lit .rname{color:#ffd79a}
.rstruct{font-size:13px;color:#b9a679;min-height:15px}
.machinery{grid-column:1;grid-row:2;display:flex;gap:4px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;align-content:center}
.unit{width:21px;height:21px;border-radius:50%;border:2px dashed #6b7f88;color:#a9bcc4;font-size:10px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#0f2129}
.room.running .unit{animation:spin 1.1s linear infinite;border-color:#ffb545;color:#ffd79a}
.room.lit .unit{animation:spin 3.4s linear infinite;border-color:#c9922e;color:#ffd79a;background:#25190a}
.room.stall .unit{animation:none;border-style:solid;border-color:#5d6e78;color:#7d9099}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.dialbox{grid-column:2;grid-row:1/3;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:1px}
.dnum{font-size:13px;color:#b9a679;letter-spacing:1px}
.room.lit .dnum{color:#ffd79a;font-weight:700}
.needle{transform-origin:35px 38px;transition:transform .75s cubic-bezier(.2,1.5,.4,1)}
.room.lit{border-color:#c9922e;background:linear-gradient(#241a09,#14100a);box-shadow:0 0 26px rgba(255,181,69,.22) inset,0 0 14px rgba(255,181,69,.14)}
.room.stall{animation:shake .5s}
@keyframes shake{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0)}20%{transform:translateX(-5px)}40%{transform:translateX(5px)}60%{transform:translateX(-3px)}80%{transform:translateX(3px)}}
.room.surge{box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(255,220,150,.85);border-color:#fff0cf}
#base{height:34px;border-radius:4px 4px 12px 12px;border:2px solid rgba(201,146,46,.3);background:linear-gradient(#0f232b,#0a181e);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:4px;color:#7d9099}
#base.on{color:#ffd79a;border-color:#c9922e;box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(255,181,69,.3)}
#cableLayer{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:25}

/* ---------- SHARED WORKSPACE PIECES ---------- */
.wsplit{display:flex;gap:14px;height:100%}
.col{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;min-width:0}
.stitle{font-size:13.5px;letter-spacing:2px;color:#c9922e;text-transform:uppercase}
.cap{font-size:15px;color:#bccad0}
.groupsView{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start}
.gbox{border:2px solid rgba(201,146,46,.6);border-radius:12px;background:rgba(201,146,46,.07);padding:8px 8px 17px;position:relative;
  display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px;align-content:flex-start;justify-content:center}
.gbox.hl{border-color:#ffb545;background:rgba(255,181,69,.2);box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(255,181,69,.4)}
.glab{position:absolute;bottom:2px;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;font-size:11px;color:#c9a86a;letter-spacing:.5px}
.token{border-radius:50%;background:#e0563f;flex:0 0 auto}
.t-apple{background:linear-gradient(#ffe08a,#e5a53f);border:1px solid #a9701f;border-radius:52% 52% 44% 44%}
.t-button{background:#6fc7d8;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,0,0,.22)}
.t-plain{background:#e8934a}
.t-seed{background:#7ecf6d;border-radius:50% 50% 50% 2px}
.t-mug{background:#efe9d8;border-radius:4px}
.t-bolt{background:#cfd6d9;border-radius:3px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
.t-bead{background:#d982e0}
.arrView{display:inline-flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);padding:6px;border-radius:10px}
.arow{display:flex;gap:3px;padding:2px;border-radius:5px}
.arow:nth-child(odd){background:rgba(201,146,46,.14)}
.arow:nth-child(even){background:rgba(201,146,46,.05)}
.arow.hl{background:rgba(255,181,69,.4)}
.cell{display:grid;place-items:center}
.cell.hl{background:rgba(255,181,69,.4);border-radius:4px}
.labwrap{display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:auto auto;gap:4px;align-items:start}
.collabs{grid-column:2;display:flex;gap:3px;padding:0 6px;visibility:hidden}
.collabs span{text-align:center;font-size:11px;color:#c9a86a}
.rowlabs{grid-column:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;padding:6px 0;visibility:hidden}
.rowlabs span{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;font-size:11px;color:#c9a86a}
.labwrap.on .collabs,.labwrap.on .rowlabs{visibility:visible}

.optRow{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.opt{flex:1 1 0;min-width:168px;min-height:92px;border:2px solid rgba(201,146,46,.45);border-radius:12px;
  background:linear-gradient(#15303a,#0f242e);padding:11px;font-size:16.5px;line-height:1.25;text-align:left;transition:.14s;position:relative}
.opt:hover{border-color:#ffb545}
.opt.sel{background:linear-gradient(#4a3413,#2b1f0c);border-color:#ffb545;box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(255,181,69,.4)}
.opt .cno{position:absolute;top:5px;right:9px;font-size:11px;color:#c9922e;letter-spacing:1px}
.btn{min-height:48px;border:2px solid rgba(201,146,46,.5);border-radius:10px;background:rgba(201,146,46,.13);padding:8px 14px;font-size:16px;color:#f2e2c0;transition:.14s}
.btn:hover{border-color:#ffb545;background:rgba(255,181,69,.2)}
.btn.small{min-height:38px;font-size:14px;padding:5px 10px}

/* tiles + slots */
.bank{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.tile{min-width:56px;height:56px;padding:0 12px;border-radius:10px;border:2px solid #8a6a26;background:linear-gradient(#e2b25c,#b8862a);
  color:#201606;font-size:25px;font-weight:800;display:grid;place-items:center;touch-action:none;transition:.12s}
.tile.picked{box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(255,181,69,.8);transform:translateY(-3px)}
.tile.small{min-width:46px;height:46px;font-size:21px}
.eqframe{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.slot{min-width:78px;height:74px;border-radius:10px;border:2px dashed rgba(201,146,46,.6);background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);
  display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:27px;font-weight:800;color:#ffd79a;position:relative;padding-top:8px}
.slot .slab{position:absolute;top:3px;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.5px;color:#a08a5c}
.slot.filled{border-style:solid;border-color:#c9922e;background:linear-gradient(#e2b25c,#b8862a);color:#201606}
.slot.filled .slab{color:#5c4515}
.slot.over{border-color:#ffb545;background:rgba(255,181,69,.25)}
.slot.bad{animation:shake .4s}
.eqfixed{font-size:29px;font-weight:800;color:#c9922e}
.ghostTile{position:absolute;z-index:60;pointer-events:none;opacity:.92}
.pbank{border:2px solid rgba(201,146,46,.4);border-radius:12px;padding:9px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.03)}
.pbank.locked{opacity:.55;border-style:dashed}
.pbank .plabel{font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:#c9922e;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.plug{width:26px;height:12px;border-radius:3px;border:2px solid #6b7f88;position:relative}
.pbank.unlocked .plug{border-color:#ffb545;background:#ffb545}
.pbank.locked .pnote{font-size:13px;color:#9db0b8}
.pbank .prow{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.ptile{min-width:74px;height:64px;border-radius:10px;border:2px solid #8a6a26;background:linear-gradient(#15303a,#0f242e);color:#ffd79a;font-size:24px;font-weight:800;display:grid;place-items:center}
.pbank.locked .ptile{cursor:default;border-color:#4a5a63;color:#7d9099;background:#0d1a20}
.ptile.sel{background:linear-gradient(#e2b25c,#b8862a);color:#201606;border-color:#ffd79a;box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(255,181,69,.5)}

/* group builder */
.builder{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;align-content:flex-start}
.gcard{width:96px;border:2px solid rgba(201,146,46,.55);border-radius:11px;background:rgba(201,146,46,.07);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.gcard.sel{border-color:#ffb545;box-shadow:0 0 16px rgba(255,181,69,.35)}
.gcard .ghead{height:22px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:0 5px;background:rgba(201,146,46,.2);font-size:11.5px;color:#f0dcae}
.gcard .gcount{font-weight:800;color:#fff0cf}
.gcard .gbody{min-height:58px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px;justify-content:center;align-content:center;padding:6px 4px}
.gminus{position:absolute;right:2px;bottom:2px;width:26px;height:22px;border-radius:6px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.35);color:#e9d6a8;font-size:16px;display:grid;place-items:center}
.gx{position:absolute;left:2px;bottom:2px;width:26px;height:22px;border-radius:6px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.35);color:#c0b191;font-size:13px;display:grid;place-items:center}
.addcard{width:96px;min-height:86px;border:2px dashed rgba(201,146,46,.6);border-radius:11px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:14px;color:#d5bf8d;text-align:center;line-height:1.2}
.addcard:hover{border-color:#ffb545;background:rgba(255,181,69,.1)}

/* array builder */
.abWrap{position:relative;display:inline-block;padding:4px}
.abGrid{display:grid;position:relative;background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);border-radius:8px;touch-action:none}
.abCell{border:1px dashed rgba(201,146,46,.18);display:grid;place-items:center}
.abCell.on{background:rgba(201,146,46,.16);border-color:rgba(201,146,46,.5)}
.abCell.ghost .token{opacity:.28}
.abHandle{position:absolute;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(#ffd79a,#c9922e);border:2px solid #8a6a26;
  display:grid;place-items:center;color:#2a1c06;font-size:16px;font-weight:800;touch-action:none;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);box-shadow:0 0 16px rgba(255,181,69,.5);z-index:5}
.readout{font-size:19px;color:#ffd79a;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.5px}
.readout small{color:#a9bcc4;font-weight:400;font-size:14px}
.stepper{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;font-size:14px;color:#bccad0}
.stepper button{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:8px;border:2px solid rgba(201,146,46,.5);font-size:19px;color:#f0dcae;background:rgba(201,146,46,.12)}
.strip{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}
.strip .sc{min-width:52px;height:40px;border-radius:8px;background:rgba(255,181,69,.16);border:1px solid #c9922e;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:17px;color:#ffd79a}
.strip .sc.in{animation:pop .3s}
@keyframes pop{from{transform:scale(.6);opacity:0}to{transform:scale(1);opacity:1}}
.twinbox{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start}
.twin{border:2px solid rgba(201,146,46,.4);border-radius:12px;padding:9px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;align-items:center}
.twin .tlab{font-size:14px;color:#d9c393;text-align:center}
.twin .tdial{font-size:22px;font-weight:800;color:#ffd79a}

/* orientation */
.orient{height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:18px}
#breakerBtn{width:330px;height:150px;border-radius:16px;border:3px solid #c9922e;background:linear-gradient(#15303a,#0d222b);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;font-size:19px;letter-spacing:2px;color:#ffd79a}
#breakerBtn .bk{width:70px;height:34px;border-radius:8px;background:#3d545e;position:relative;transition:.25s}
#breakerBtn .bk::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:4px;top:4px;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:6px;background:#c9c2b0;transition:.25s}
#breakerBtn.on .bk{background:#c9922e}
#breakerBtn.on .bk::after{left:38px;background:#fff0cf}
.ocap{font-size:19px;line-height:1.35;max-width:640px;text-align:center;color:#f2e7d1;min-height:56px}
.ocap b{color:#ffcd7a}
.demoRow{display:flex;gap:14px;justify-content:center}
.demo{width:206px;height:132px;border:1px dashed rgba(201,146,46,.4);border-radius:12px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:rgba(255,255,255,.03)}
.demo .dlab{position:absolute;bottom:6px;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;font-size:13px;color:#c9922e;letter-spacing:1px}
.ghosth{position:absolute;width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.9);box-shadow:0 0 14px #fff}
.dcard{position:absolute;left:24px;top:24px;width:100px;height:46px;border:2px solid rgba(201,146,46,.5);border-radius:8px;background:#16303a}
.dslot{position:absolute;right:22px;top:26px;width:52px;height:44px;border:2px dashed rgba(201,146,46,.6);border-radius:8px}
.dtile{position:absolute;left:22px;top:26px;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:8px;background:linear-gradient(#e2b25c,#b8862a)}
.dgrid{position:absolute;left:30px;top:20px;width:60px;height:44px;background:rgba(201,146,46,.25);border:2px solid #c9922e;border-radius:4px}
@keyframes gh1{0%{transform:translate(20px,96px);opacity:0}15%{opacity:1}45%,60%{transform:translate(64px,40px)}100%{transform:translate(64px,40px);opacity:0}}
@keyframes gh2{0%{transform:translate(34px,42px);opacity:0}12%{opacity:1}60%,75%{transform:translate(150px,42px)}100%{transform:translate(150px,42px);opacity:0}}
@keyframes gh3{0%{transform:translate(88px,60px);opacity:0}12%{opacity:1}60%,75%{transform:translate(140px,86px)}100%{transform:translate(140px,86px);opacity:0}}
@keyframes dc{0%,40%{background:#16303a}55%,80%{background:#4a3413;border-color:#ffb545}100%{background:#16303a}}
@keyframes dt{0%,10%{transform:translate(0,0)}60%,80%{transform:translate(116px,0)}100%{transform:translate(116px,0)}}
@keyframes dg{0%,10%{width:60px;height:44px}60%,85%{width:112px;height:70px}100%{width:112px;height:70px}}
.demo1 .ghosth{animation:gh1 3.2s infinite}.demo1 .dcard{animation:dc 3.2s infinite}
.demo2 .ghosth{animation:gh2 3.2s infinite}.demo2 .dtile{animation:dt 3.2s infinite}
.demo3 .ghosth{animation:gh3 3.2s infinite}.demo3 .dgrid{animation:dg 3.2s infinite}

/* tier / mode choice */
.choiceRow{display:flex;gap:16px;height:100%;align-items:center;justify-content:center}

<body>
<div id="fit"><div id="stage">
  <div id="left">
    <div id="hdr"><span id="phase">Room 0 · Breaker</span><span id="roomTitle">Master breaker</span></div>
    <div id="prompt"></div>
    <div id="work"></div>
    <div id="footer">
      <button id="intercomBtn" type="button"><span class="speaker"></span>INTERCOM<small>ask for a hint</small></button>

    </div>
    <div id="hintPanel" class="hidden">
      <div class="hp-head"><span>INTERCOM — one hint per tap</span><button id="hintClose" type="button">close</button></div>

      <div id="voltWrap"><div id="voltFill"></div></div>

    </div>

  </div>
  <svg id="cableLayer" viewBox="0 0 1365 768" preserveAspectRatio="none">

    <circle id="pulseDot" r="6" fill="#ffd79a" opacity="0"/>
  </svg>
</div></div>

<script>
"use strict";
(function(){
const UPSTREAM_HASH="d92f1d990c53245675adb83d1ab739b3b659c0a116902b736340201349b89302";
const RM = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
const stage=document.getElementById('stage'), work=document.getElementById('work'),
      promptEl=document.getElementById('prompt'), phaseEl=document.getElementById('phase'),
      titleEl=document.getElementById('roomTitle'), plateEl=document.getElementById('plate'),
      plateText=document.getElementById('plateText'), sendBtn=document.getElementById('send'),
      sendLabel=document.getElementById('sendLabel'), roomsCol=document.getElementById('roomsCol'),
      voltFill=document.getElementById('voltFill'), deck=document.getElementById('deck'),
      base=document.getElementById('base'), cablePath=document.getElementById('cablePath'),
      pulseDot=document.getElementById('pulseDot'), hintPanel=document.getElementById('hintPanel'),
      hintList=document.getElementById('hintList'), hintMore=document.getElementById('hintMore'),
      intercomBtn=document.getElementById('intercomBtn');

/* ---------- fit ---------- */
function fit(){const k=Math.min(window.innerWidth/1365, window.innerHeight/768);stage.style.transform='scale('+k+')';}
window.addEventListener('resize',fit);fit();

/* ---------- utils ---------- */
function el(t,c,x){const e=document.createElement(t);if(c)e.className=c;if(x!=null)e.textContent=x;return e;}
function sleep(ms){return new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,RM?0:ms));}
function clamp(v,a,b){return Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));}
function stageRect(node){const s=stage.getBoundingClientRect(),r=node.getBoundingClientRect(),k=s.width/1365;
  return {x:(r.left-s.left)/k,y:(r.top-s.top)/k,w:r.width/k,h:r.height/k};}
function skipList(step,n){const a=[];for(let i=1;i<=n;i++)a.push(step*i);return a;}

/* ---------- telemetry ---------- */
const T={buf:[],lastAct:performance.now(),
 log(name,data){const rec=Object.assign({ms:Math.round(performance.now()),room:(window.R?R.n:null),name:name},data||{});
   T.buf.push(rec);try{console.log('[telemetry]',JSON.stringify(rec));}catch(e){}},
 flush(){try{console.log('[telemetry:flush]',JSON.stringify({hash:UPSTREAM_HASH,events:T.buf}));}catch(e){}}};
document.addEventListener('pointerdown',()=>{T.lastAct=performance.now();},true);
setInterval(()=>{if(!window.R)return;const idle=performance.now()-T.lastAct;
  if(idle>45000 && !R.idleLogged){R.idleLogged=true;T.log('silent_struggle_idle',{item:R.item,idle_ms:Math.round(idle),misses_since_hint:R.missesSinceHint,hints:R.hintLevel});}},5000);

/* ---------- tower ---------- */
const ROOM_NAMES=['','Gear Floor','Piston Floor','Foundry','Twin Panel Floor','Turbine Floor','Auxiliary Floor','Signal Deck'];
const Tower={rooms:{},lit:new Set()};
(function buildTower(){
 for(let n=1;n<=7;n++){
   const r=el('div','room');r.id='room'+n;
   r.innerHTML='<span class="pilot"></span>'+
     '<div class="rmeta"><div class="rname">'+n+' · '+ROOM_NAMES[n]+'</div><div class="rstruct"></div></div>'+
     '<div class="machinery"></div>'+
     '<div class="dialbox"><svg viewBox="0 0 70 42" width="70" height="40">'+
     '<path d="M8 38 A27 27 0 0 1 62 38" fill="none" stroke="#31434b" stroke-width="4"/>'+
     '<line class="needle" x1="35" y1="38" x2="35" y2="13" stroke="#ffb545" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" style="transform:rotate(-90deg)"/>'+
     '<circle cx="35" cy="38" r="3" fill="#c9922e"/></svg><div class="dnum">0 W</div></div>';
   roomsCol.appendChild(r);Tower.rooms[n]=r;
 }
})();
function setDial(n,v){const r=Tower.rooms[n];const a=-90+180*clamp(v,0,100)/100;
  r.querySelector('.needle').style.transform='rotate('+a+'deg)';r.querySelector('.dnum').textContent=v+' W';}
function setActiveRoom(n){for(let i=1;i<=7;i++)Tower.rooms[i].classList.toggle('active',i===n);}
function updateVolt(){voltFill.style.height=(Tower.lit.size/7*100)+'%';
  deck.textContent = Tower.lit.size===7?'SIGNAL DECK · ARMED':'SIGNAL DECK · '+Tower.lit.size+' OF 7 ROOMS POWERED';
  deck.classList.toggle('armed',Tower.lit.size===7);}
function drawCable(){
  const target = (R && R.n>0)?Tower.rooms[R.n]:base;
  const a=stageRect(sendBtn), b=stageRect(target);
  const x1=a.x+a.w/2,y1=a.y+6,x2=b.x-4,y2=b.y+b.h/2;
  cablePath.setAttribute('d','M'+x1+' '+y1+' C '+(x1)+' '+(y1-90)+', '+(x2-140)+' '+y2+', '+x2+' '+y2);
}
function pulseCable(){return new Promise(res=>{
  if(RM){res();return;}
  const len=cablePath.getTotalLength();const t0=performance.now();pulseDot.setAttribute('opacity','1');
  (function step(t){const p=clamp((t-t0)/430,0,1);const pt=cablePath.getPointAtLength(len*p);
   pulseDot.setAttribute('cx',pt.x);pulseDot.setAttribute('cy',pt.y);
   if(p<1)requestAnimationFrame(step);else{pulseDot.setAttribute('opacity','0');res();}})(t0);});}
async function runRoom(n,o){
  const room=Tower.rooms[n],mach=room.querySelector('.machinery'),struct=room.querySelector('.rstruct');
  mach.innerHTML='';
  const g=clamp(o.groups||0,0,12);
  for(let i=0;i<g;i++){const u=el('div','unit',(o.per!=null?String(o.per):''));mach.appendChild(u);}
  struct.textContent = (o.groups!=null&&o.per!=null)? (o.groups+' units × '+o.per) : '';
  drawCable();await pulseCable();
  room.classList.add('running');await sleep(620);room.classList.remove('running');
  if(o.ok){room.classList.add('lit');setDial(n,o.product);Tower.lit.add(n);updateVolt();await sleep(500);}
  else{room.classList.add('stall');setDial(n,0);await sleep(600);room.classList.remove('stall');}
}

/* ---------- plate + send ---------- */
function plate(msg,kind){plateEl.className='';if(kind)plateEl.classList.add(kind);plateText.textContent=msg;}
function nudge(msg){plate(msg,'nudge');}
function setSend(label,ready,mode){sendLabel.textContent=label;sendBtn.classList.toggle('ready',!!ready);
  sendBtn.classList.toggle('next',mode==='next');sendBtn.dataset.mode=mode||'send';}

/* ---------- drag / tap tile system ---------- */
let picked=null,ghost=null,dragging=null,moved=false,startPt=null;
function bindTile(tile,payload){
  tile.dataset.kind=payload.kind;tile.dataset.value=payload.value;
  tile.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{
    e.preventDefault();dragging=tile;moved=false;startPt={x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY};
    tile.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
    ghost=tile.cloneNode(true);ghost.classList.add('ghostTile');ghost.style.position='absolute';
    stage.appendChild(ghost);moveGhost(e.clientX,e.clientY);ghost.style.display='none';
  });
  tile.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{
    if(dragging!==tile)return;
    if(!moved && (Math.abs(e.clientX-startPt.x)>7||Math.abs(e.clientY-startPt.y)>7)){moved=true;if(ghost)ghost.style.display='';}
    if(moved){moveGhost(e.clientX,e.clientY);highlightSlot(e.clientX,e.clientY);}
  });
  tile.addEventListener('pointerup',e=>{
    if(dragging!==tile)return;
    if(ghost){ghost.remove();ghost=null;}
    clearSlotHl();
    if(moved){const slot=slotAt(e.clientX,e.clientY);if(slot)tryPlace(slot,payload,tile);}
    else{ // tap-to-pick
      if(picked && picked.el===tile){picked.el.classList.remove('picked');picked=null;}
      else{if(picked)picked.el.classList.remove('picked');picked={el:tile,payload:payload};tile.classList.add('picked');
        nudge('Tile picked up. Now tap a slot to place it.');}
    }
    dragging=null;moved=false;
  });
  tile.addEventListener('pointercancel',()=>{if(ghost){ghost.remove();ghost=null;}clearSlotHl();dragging=null;});
}
function moveGhost(cx,cy){const s=stage.getBoundingClientRect(),k=s.width/1365;
  ghost.style.left=((cx-s.left)/k-30)+'px';ghost.style.top=((cy-s.top)/k-30)+'px';}
function slotAt(cx,cy){const n=document.elementFromPoint(cx,cy);return n?n.closest('.slot'):null;}
function highlightSlot(cx,cy){clearSlotHl();const s=slotAt(cx,cy);if(s)s.classList.add('over');}
function clearSlotHl(){document.querySelectorAll('.slot.over').forEach(s=>s.classList.remove('over'));}
function tryPlace(slot,payload,tileEl){
  if(slot.dataset.accept && slot.dataset.accept!==payload.kind){
    slot.classList.add('bad');setTimeout(()=>slot.classList.remove('bad'),420);
    nudge(slot.dataset.accept==='num'?'That slot takes a number.':'That slot takes a sign (× or +).');
    T.log('slot_reject',{item:R.item,accept:slot.dataset.accept,kind:payload.kind});return;}
  slot.dataset.value=payload.value;slot.classList.add('filled');
  slot.querySelector('.sval').textContent=payload.value;
  if(picked){picked.el.classList.remove('picked');picked=null;}
  if(slot._onChange)slot._onChange();
  plate('');
}
function makeSlot(label,accept,onChange){
  const s=el('div','slot');s.dataset.accept=accept;
  s.appendChild(el('span','slab',label));s.appendChild(el('span','sval',''));
  s._onChange=onChange;
  s.addEventListener('click',()=>{
    if(picked){tryPlace(s,picked.payload,picked.el);return;}
    if(s.classList.contains('filled')){delete s.dataset.value;s.classList.remove('filled');s.querySelector('.sval').textContent='';
      nudge('Slot cleared.');if(onChange)onChange();}
  });
  return s;
}
function bankOf(items,cls){const b=el('div','bank');items.forEach(it=>{const t=el('div','tile'+(cls?' '+cls:''),String(it.value));
  bindTile(t,it);b.appendChild(t);});return b;}

/* ---------- views ---------- */
function groupsView(n,k,cls,o){o=o||{};const size=o.size||18,perRow=o.perRow||3;
  const w=el('div','groupsView');
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const b=el('div','gbox');b.style.width=(perRow*(size+5)+18)+'px';
    for(let j=0;j<k;j++){const t=el('div','token '+cls);t.style.width=size+'px';t.style.height=size+'px';b.appendChild(t);}
    b.appendChild(el('div','glab',o.label?o.label(i):String(k)));w.appendChild(b);}
  return w;}
function arrayView(rows,cols,cls,size){const w=el('div','arrView');
  for(let r=0;r<rows;r++){const rw=el('div','arow');
    for(let c=0;c<cols;c++){const cell=el('div','cell');cell.style.width=(size+5)+'px';cell.style.height=(size+5)+'px';
      const t=el('div','token '+cls);t.style.width=size+'px';t.style.height=size+'px';cell.appendChild(t);rw.appendChild(cell);}
    w.appendChild(rw);}return w;}

/* ---------- group builder ---------- */
function groupBuilder(host,o){
  o=o||{};const maxG=o.maxGroups||9,maxT=o.maxTokens||9,size=o.size||14,cls=o.tokenClass||'t-plain';
  const st={groups:[]};const wrap=el('div','builder');host.appendChild(wrap);
  function render(){
    wrap.innerHTML='';
    st.groups.forEach((cnt,i)=>{
      const c=el('div','gcard');
      const h=el('div','ghead');h.appendChild(el('span',null,'group '+(i+1)));h.appendChild(el('span','gcount',String(cnt)));
      const body=el('div','gbody');
      for(let j=0;j<cnt;j++){const t=el('div','token '+cls);t.style.width=size+'px';t.style.height=size+'px';body.appendChild(t);}
      body.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(st.groups[i]<maxT){st.groups[i]++;T.lastAct=performance.now();render();change('add token');}
        else nudge('That group already holds '+maxT+'.');});
      const m=el('button','gminus','−');m.type='button';
      m.addEventListener('click',ev=>{ev.stopPropagation();if(st.groups[i]>0){st.groups[i]--;render();change('remove token');}});
      const x=el('button','gx','✕');x.type='button';
      x.addEventListener('click',ev=>{ev.stopPropagation();st.groups.splice(i,1);render();change('remove group');});
      c.appendChild(h);c.appendChild(body);c.appendChild(m);c.appendChild(x);wrap.appendChild(c);
    });
    if(st.groups.length<maxG){
      const a=el('div','addcard','+ add\ngroup');a.addEventListener('click',()=>{st.groups.push(0);render();change('add group');});
      wrap.appendChild(a);}
  }
  function change(what){if(o.onChange)o.onChange(st,what);}
  render();
  return {state:st,render:render,set(counts){st.groups=counts.slice();render();change('set');}};
}

/* ---------- array builder ---------- */
function arrayBuilder(host,o){
  o=o||{};const maxR=o.maxR||10,maxC=o.maxC||10,cell=o.cell||30,size=o.size||16,cls=o.tokenClass||'t-plain';
  const st={rows:o.rows||1,cols:o.cols||1};
  const holder=el('div','col');
  const readout=el('div','readout');
  const wrap=el('div','abWrap');const grid=el('div','abGrid');
  grid.style.gridTemplateColumns='repeat('+maxC+','+cell+'px)';
  grid.style.gridTemplateRows='repeat('+maxR+','+cell+'px)';
  const cells=[];
  for(let r=0;r<maxR;r++){for(let c=0;c<maxC;c++){
    const cl=el('div','abCell');cl.dataset.r=r;cl.dataset.c=c;
    const t=el('div','token '+cls);t.style.width=size+'px';t.style.height=size+'px';t.style.visibility='hidden';cl.appendChild(t);
    cl.addEventListener('click',()=>{st.rows=r+1;st.cols=c+1;paint();change();});
    grid.appendChild(cl);cells.push(cl);}}
  const handle=el('div','abHandle','⇲');
  wrap.appendChild(grid);wrap.appendChild(handle);
  const steps=el('div','stepper');
  function stepBtn(txt,fn){const b=el('button',null,txt);b.type='button';b.addEventListener('click',()=>{fn();paint();change();});return b;}
  steps.appendChild(el('span',null,'rows'));
  steps.appendChild(stepBtn('−',()=>{st.rows=clamp(st.rows-1,1,maxR);}));
  steps.appendChild(stepBtn('+',()=>{st.rows=clamp(st.rows+1,1,maxR);}));
  steps.appendChild(el('span',null,'in each row'));
  steps.appendChild(stepBtn('−',()=>{st.cols=clamp(st.cols-1,1,maxC);}));
  steps.appendChild(stepBtn('+',()=>{st.cols=clamp(st.cols+1,1,maxC);}));
  holder.appendChild(readout);holder.appendChild(wrap);holder.appendChild(steps);host.appendChild(holder);
  function paint(){
    cells.forEach(cl=>{const r=+cl.dataset.r,c=+cl.dataset.c;const on=(r<st.rows&&c<st.cols);
      cl.classList.toggle('on',on);cl.classList.remove('ghost');
      cl.firstChild.style.visibility=on?'visible':'hidden';
      if(!on&&o.ghost&&r<o.ghost.rows&&c<o.ghost.cols){cl.classList.add('ghost');cl.firstChild.style.visibility='visible';}});
    handle.style.left=(st.cols*cell)+'px';handle.style.top=(st.rows*cell)+'px';
    readout.innerHTML='rows: <b>'+st.rows+'</b>  ·  in each row: <b>'+st.cols+'</b> <small>(drag the round handle, tap a cell, or use − +)</small>';
  }
  function change(){T.lastAct=performance.now();if(o.onChange)o.onChange(st);}
  let drag=false;
  handle.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{e.preventDefault();drag=true;handle.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);});
  handle.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(!drag)return;
    const g=grid.getBoundingClientRect();
    st.cols=clamp(Math.ceil((e.clientX-g.left)/(g.width/maxC)),1,maxC);
    st.rows=clamp(Math.ceil((e.clientY-g.top)/(g.height/maxR)),1,maxR);paint();change();});
  handle.addEventListener('pointerup',()=>{drag=false;});
  handle.addEventListener('pointercancel',()=>{drag=false;});
  paint();
  return {state:st,paint:paint,set(r,c){st.rows=r;st.cols=c;paint();change();}};
}

/* ---------- product bank ---------- */
function productBank(host,values,label){
  const b=el('div','pbank locked');
  const lab=el('div','plabel');lab.appendChild(el('span','plug'));lab.appendChild(el('span',null,label||'PRODUCT BANK'));
  const note=el('div','pnote','Cable unplugged — the bank connects when your build checks out.');
  const row=el('div','prow');const api={value:null};
  values.forEach(v=>{const t=el('div','ptile',String(v));
    t.addEventListener('click',()=>{if(b.classList.contains('locked')){nudge('The product bank is not plugged in yet. Send your build first.');return;}
      row.querySelectorAll('.ptile').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('sel'));t.classList.add('sel');api.value=v;
      T.log('product_tap',{item:R.item,value:v});plate('');});
    row.appendChild(t);});
  b.appendChild(lab);b.appendChild(note);b.appendChild(row);host.appendChild(b);
  api.unlock=function(){b.classList.remove('locked');b.classList.add('unlocked');note.textContent='Connected. Tap the product this build sends to the dial.';};
  api.el=b;return api;}

/* ---------- option tiles ---------- */
function optionRow(labels,onSel){
  const row=el('div','optRow');
  labels.forEach((tx,i)=>{const b=el('button','opt');b.type='button';
    b.appendChild(el('span','cno','CARTRIDGE '+String.fromCharCode(65+i)));
    b.appendChild(el('span',null,tx));
    b.addEventListener('click',()=>{row.querySelectorAll('.opt').forEach(o=>o.classList.remove('sel'));b.classList.add('sel');onSel(i);plate('');});
    row.appendChild(b);});
  return row;}

/* ---------- session record ---------- */
const record=[];
let R=null;window.R=null;let busy=false;

/* ---------- shell ---------- */
function mountRoom(n){
  R={n:n,stage:1,sel:null,hintLevel:0,misses:0,missesSinceHint:0,taps:[],t0:performance.now(),idleLogged:false,item:'item-0'+n};
  window.R=R;
  work.innerHTML='';hintList.innerHTML='';hintPanel.classList.add('hidden');
  hintMore.disabled=false;hintMore.textContent='ask for the next hint';
  plate('');setActiveRoom(n);setSend('SEND',false,'send');
  const def=ROOMS[n];phaseEl.textContent=def.phase;titleEl.textContent=def.title;
  typePrompt(def.prompt);
  R.hints=[];def.mount();
  drawCable();
  T.log('room_open',{item:R.item,phase:def.phase});
}
let typeTimer=null;
function typePrompt(html){
  clearInterval(typeTimer);
  if(RM){promptEl.innerHTML=html;return;}
  const tmp=el('div');tmp.innerHTML=html;const plain=tmp.textContent;
  promptEl.textContent='';let i=0;
  typeTimer=setInterval(()=>{i+=3;promptEl.textContent=plain.slice(0,i);
    if(i>=plain.length){clearInterval(typeTimer);promptEl.innerHTML=html;}},12);
}
async function succeed(o){
  T.log('answer_correct',{item:R.item,attempts:R.misses,hints_used:R.hintLevel,latency_ms:Math.round(performance.now()-R.t0)});
  record.push(o.record);
  await runRoom(R.n,{groups:o.groups,per:o.per,product:o.product,ok:true});
  plate(o.msg,'good');
  setSend(R.n<7?('OPEN ROOM '+(R.n+1)+' →'):'SEND THE SIGNAL →',true,'next');
}
async function fail(msg,o){
  o=o||{};R.misses++;R.missesSinceHint++;
  T.log('answer_incorrect',{item:R.item,detail:o.detail||null,attempt:o.attempt||null,misses_since_hint:R.missesSinceHint,hints_used:R.hintLevel});
  await runRoom(R.n,{groups:o.groups,per:o.per,product:0,ok:false});
  plate(msg,'fault');
  if(R.missesSinceHint>=2 && R.hintLevel===0){intercomBtn.classList.add('pulse');setTimeout(()=>intercomBtn.classList.remove('pulse'),6500);}
}

function constellationSVG(rec){
  const W=158,H=132;const svg=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','svg');
  svg.setAttribute('viewBox','0 0 '+W+' '+H);svg.setAttribute('width',W);svg.setAttribute('height',H);
  const pts=[];const lines=[];
  if(rec.mode==='array'){
    const sx=Math.min(13,(W-24)/rec.k),sy=Math.min(12,(H-24)/rec.g);
    const ox=(W-(rec.k-1)*sx)/2, oy=(H-(rec.g-1)*sy)/2;
    for(let r=0;r<rec.g;r++){const rowPts=[];
      for(let c=0;c<rec.k;c++){const p={x:ox+c*sx,y:oy+r*sy};pts.push(p);rowPts.push(p);}
      for(let i=1;i<rowPts.length;i++)lines.push([rowPts[i-1],rowPts[i]]);}
  } else {
    const perRow=Math.min(3,rec.k);const gRows=Math.ceil(rec.k/perRow);
    const cols=Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(rec.g));const rows=Math.ceil(rec.g/cols);
    const cw=(W-16)/cols, ch=(H-16)/rows;
    for(let g=0;g<rec.g;g++){
      const gx=8+(g%cols)*cw, gy=8+Math.floor(g/cols)*ch;
      const dx=Math.min(9,(cw-6)/Math.max(1,perRow)), dy=Math.min(9,(ch-6)/Math.max(1,gRows));
      const cluster=[];
      for(let t=0;t<rec.k;t++){const p={x:gx+cw/2-((perRow-1)*dx)/2+(t%perRow)*dx, y:gy+ch/2-((gRows-1)*dy)/2+Math.floor(t/perRow)*dy};
        pts.push(p);cluster.push(p);}
      for(let i=1;i<cluster.length;i++)lines.push([cluster[i-1],cluster[i]]);
    }
  }
  lines.forEach(L=>{const l=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','line');
    l.setAttribute('x1',L[0].x);l.setAttribute('y1',L[0].y);l.setAttribute('x2',L[1].x);l.setAttribute('y2',L[1].y);
    l.setAttribute('class','starline');svg.appendChild(l);});
  pts.forEach((p,i)=>{const c=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','circle');
    c.setAttribute('cx',p.x);c.setAttribute('cy',p.y);c.setAttribute('r',2.3);c.setAttribute('class','star');
    c.style.opacity='0';c.style.animation='fadeIn .3s forwards';c.style.animationDelay=(i*8)+'ms';svg.appendChild(c);});
  return svg;
}
